research_topic.title: Artificial Intelligence in Alzheimer's Disease Research
research_topic.description: Applications of artificial intelligence to understanding, detecting, diagnosing, predicting, monitoring, and treating Alzheimer's disease. The collection is restricted to papers published from January 1, 2020 through June 19, 2026.

include_criteria: Papers directly studying the application of AI in Alzheimer's disease research
Papers investigating related technologies, methodologies, and frameworks that apply to AI and Alzheimer's
Review articles that summarize and synthesize existing research in this area
Empirical studies that provide evidence of AI effectiveness in Alzheimer's diagnosis or treatment
Papers published from January 1, 2020 through June 19, 2026
exclude_criteria: Papers lacking a substantive connection to AI in Alzheimer's disease
Papers focused only on other neurological diseases without an explicit Alzheimer's disease analysis
Papers published before 2020 or after June 19, 2026
boundary_rules: Include borderline papers that discuss AI technologies relevant to the field of Alzheimer's
Exclude papers whose titles and abstracts clearly indicate they are unrelated

research_topic.title: Artificial Intelligence in Alzheimer's Disease Research
research_topic.description: Applications of artificial intelligence to understanding, detecting, diagnosing, predicting, monitoring, and treating Alzheimer's disease. The collection is restricted to papers published from January 1, 2020 through June 19, 2026.

include_criteria: Papers directly studying the application of AI in Alzheimer's disease research
Papers investigating related technologies, methodologies, and frameworks that apply to AI and Alzheimer's
Review articles that summarize and synthesize existing research in this area
Empirical studies that provide evidence of AI effectiveness in Alzheimer's diagnosis or treatment
Papers published from January 1, 2020 through June 19, 2026
exclude_criteria: Papers lacking a substantive connection to AI in Alzheimer's disease
Papers focused only on other neurological diseases without an explicit Alzheimer's disease analysis
Papers published before 2020 or after June 19, 2026
boundary_rules: Include borderline papers that discuss AI technologies relevant to the field of Alzheimer's
Exclude papers whose titles and abstracts clearly indicate they are unrelated
